cycles.root_cause: Planning gates and process-local adapter state were insufficient as durable paid-call authority.
cycles.repair: Added immutable scoped preflight, durable flocked attempt ledger, request/preflight hashes, exact execution token and controlled runner.

cycles.root_cause: Structural JPEG marker parsing did not prove that entropy data was fully decodable.
cycles.repair: Reused the existing full FFmpeg binary for bounded one-frame safe decode and retained stdlib full PNG validation.
checks_rerun: valid and corrupt JPEG safety tests

cycles.root_cause: A successful ledger state could precede durable image materialization.
cycles.repair: Prebound the output destination and moved .part/fsync/decode/checksum/atomic rename before ledger SUCCEEDED.
checks_rerun: success, failure, replay and concurrency adapter tests

cycles.root_cause: Typed rights evidence did not yet prove original provider bytes derived the normalized PNG under VQC.
cycles.repair: Added hash-bound materialization/normalization contracts, actual-byte reprobes and request/ID/cost/ledger lineage checks.
checks_rerun: real JPEG lineage positive and tamper-negative VQC tests

cycles.root_cause: An interrupted upload could not safely resume or prove an exact non-duplicate remote package.
cycles.repair: Added atomic per-file journal, Drive listing reconciliation, exact item-set checks, canonical manifest upload and same-ID resume.
checks_rerun: Drive archive suite including interruption and duplicate cases

cycles.root_cause: The pre-rename normalization receipt recorded the temporary part file as still present, causing five typed-chain failures.
cycles.repair: Persisted intended final part state, retained crash recovery from the bound sidecar, then reran focused VQC and controlled render/archive tests.

cycles.root_cause: The human packet recomputed a native render receipt hash from JSON-mode timestamps while the renderer authority hashes Python-mode aware datetimes.
cycles.repair: Matched the existing renderer receipt authority, retained exact manifest/Drive/local/VQC/attempt checks, and reran the fake end-to-end human-boundary test.
checks_rerun: controlled runner through pending human packet

cycles.root_cause: Per-run ledgers, a public execution token and CLI self-attestations did not prevent a fresh run from spending a second task authorization or faking credential rotation.
cycles.repair: Added a fixed-path task-wide AVAILABLE/CLAIMED/CONSUMED authority, compromised-key fingerprint comparison, private flocked state and cross-run concurrency tests.

cycles.root_cause: An unvalidated model copy could tamper with the cost snapshot, and atomic replaces did not fsync their parent directories.
cycles.repair: Froze and canonically revalidated cost snapshots against request/catalog truth; added parent-directory fsync after provider output, attempt, normalization, artifact and Drive state replaces.

cycles.root_cause: A preflight-time reservation could strand monthly capacity when another non-budget gate remained blocked.
cycles.repair: Made capacity inspection read-only, bound it to the configured dedicated cap, then claim the task and reserve atomically immediately before submit; mark spend only from the consumed attempt ledger.

cycles.root_cause: The documented CLI stopped after image materialization and did not execute VQC, native render, Drive verification or human-packet creation.
cycles.repair: Added sanitized pre-submit Drive readiness, truthful run-local reports and a no-generation post-paid pipeline through verified archive and PENDING human review.

cycles.root_cause: The human packet compared only the receipt path set, allowing a self-consistent VERIFIED receipt whose per-item hashes differed from the archive manifest.
cycles.repair: Bound every receipt item and the canonical manifest to local/remote size, SHA-256 or Drive MD5, nonempty file ID, unique path and exact aggregate sizes.

cycles.root_cause: A direct adapter caller could reuse a planning PASS preflight and clone the per-run attempt ledger while bypassing the live task-wide claim, shared reservation and credential authority.
cycles.repair: Derived and persisted a CLAIMED/RESERVED runtime-submit preflight after the canonical claim and reservation; the adapter now requires exact canonical workspace, attempt, preflight and gate paths plus live task, budget, credential and catalog-cost equality. The runner rejects substituted authority paths and revalidates cost immediately before claim.

cycles.root_cause: The review MP4 rename did not fsync the completed file and output directory, and newly created security authority directories did not fsync every parent entry.
cycles.repair: Fsynced the completed MP4 before rename and its parent after rename; created private authority directories one level at a time and fsynced each new directory and parent entry.

cycles.root_cause: The expanded offline rerun exposed that the legacy synthetic smoke builder still selected VideoToolbox and failed with encoder error -12908 on the current host.
cycles.repair: Aligned the non-production synthetic smoke builder with the deterministic libx264 path already used by the canary review renderer, preserving H.264, 1080p and BT.709 policy.
checks_rerun: native synthetic render and media QC

cycles.root_cause: The adapter checked the caller-supplied store path but still trusted its load, consume and finalize methods, so a wrapper could self-report the canonical path while keeping an independent ledger.
cycles.repair: The adapter now reopens the repository's concrete flocked attempt store internally from the derived canonical path and uses only that instance for every state transition; caller methods are ignored.

cycles.root_cause: The canary's dedicated internal AI-image monthly cap was USD 0 even though the operator confirmed more than USD 20 of Google AI Studio quota remained.
cycles.repair: Set the local dedicated AI-image monthly budget to USD 20 while retaining the immutable USD 0.15 per-request hard cap, then created a new preflight-only run.

cycles.root_cause: The existing Drive refresh credential was present and unrevoked, but the local Python TLS chain could not validate Google's certificate with the default CA path.
cycles.repair: Bound the canary subprocess to the environment's certifi CA bundle without changing or exposing the OAuth token.

cycles.root_cause: The previously configured Drive root ID returned HTTP 404 even after OAuth refresh succeeded.
cycles.repair: Created or reused one empty dedicated VCOS IMG Canary folder, verified its folder MIME type and updated only the local ignored Drive root configuration.

cycles.root_cause: The SDK accepted a mixed old/new request shape that sent legacy response_modalities together with the May-2026 polymorphic response_format; the server rejected it with HTTP 400. A non-generating metadata GET later proved the rotated key, model access, 2K and 16:9 were valid.
cycles.repair: No provider retry was attempted because the submission had already consumed the one authorized generation attempt.

cycles.root_cause: The adapter combined the removed response_modalities selector with the May-2026 polymorphic response_format instead of matching the current official image-generation request.
cycles.repair: Removed response_modalities, retained a single image response_format with JPEG, inline delivery, 16:9 and 2K, kept store=false, and preserved disabled SDK retries and exact-one durable authorities.
checks_rerun: IMG canary and IMG1 provider suites: 42 passed

cycles.root_cause: The one-shot preflight did not prove that the bounded FFmpeg runtime advertised an MJPEG/JPEG decoder before attempt consumption, and the request tests did not yet exercise the official SDK's serialized HTTP body or a fully decodable JPEG success path.
cycles.repair: Added a typed decoder-readiness preflight gate, a live decoder recheck before attempt consumption, initial legacy-artifact hash compatibility, explicit inline delivery, official-SDK MockTransport body coverage and a real valid-JPEG full-decode success test.

cycles.root_cause: Backward-compatible loading allowed raster_decoder_ready=null artifacts to retain historical PASS status, but the execution boundary did not yet distinguish those read-only legacy records from newly executable typed preflight evidence; hash derivation also used inconsistent payload shapes.
cycles.repair: Centralized canonical preflight hash payloads, required raster_decoder_ready=true plus the exact decoder evidence hash in execution-gate derivation and both planning/runtime persisted-submit authorities, retained null only for read-only historical validation, and added a zero-attempt/no-transport legacy rejection regression.
